questions.question: Please list the product descriptions of the transactions taken place in the gas stations in the Czech Republic.
questions.evidence: Czech Republic can be represented as the Country value in the gasstations table is 'CZE';
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T3.Description FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID INNER JOIN products AS T3 ON T1.ProductID = T3.ProductID WHERE T2.Country = 'CZE'

questions.question: What is the ratio of customers who pay in EUR against customers who pay in CZK?
questions.evidence: ratio of customers who pay in EUR against customers who pay in CZK = count(Currency = 'EUR') / count(Currency = 'CZK').
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) / SUM(IIF(Currency = 'CZK', 1, 0)) AS ratio FROM customers

questions.question: Is it true that more SMEs pay in Czech koruna than in euros? If so, how many more?
questions.evidence: Amount of more SMEs = Total of SMEs pay using Currency CZK - Total of SMEs pay using Currency EUR
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(Currency = 'CZK') - SUM(Currency = 'EUR') FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME'

questions.question: What was the difference in gas consumption between CZK-paying customers and EUR-paying customers in 2012?
questions.evidence: Year 2012 can be presented as Between 201201 And 201212; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; Difference in Consumption = CZK customers consumption in 2012 - EUR customers consumption in 2012
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(IIF(T1.Currency = 'CZK', T2.Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.Currency = 'EUR', T2.Consumption, 0)) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'

questions.question: What is the percentage of "premium" against the overall segment in Country = "SVK"?
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(Country = 'SVK' AND Segment = 'Premium', 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(IIF(Country = 'SVK', 1, 0)) FROM gasstations

questions.question: How many more "discount" gas stations does the Czech Republic have compared to Slovakia?
questions.evidence: Czech Republic can be represented as the Country value in gasstations table is 'CZE'; Slovakia can be represented as the Country value in the gasstations table is 'SVK';  Computation of more "discount" gas stations= Total no. of discount gas stations in Czech Republic - Total no. of discount gas stations in Slovakia
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(IIF(Country = 'CZE', 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(Country = 'SVK', 1, 0)) FROM gasstations WHERE Segment = 'Discount'

questions.question: For all the transactions happened during 8:00-9:00 in 2012/8/26, how many happened in CZE?
questions.evidence: Czech Republic can be represented as the Country value in the gasstations table is 'CZE'; '2012/8/26' can be represented by '2012-08-26'; during 8:00-9:00 can be represented as Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00'
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.TransactionID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-26' AND T1.Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00' AND T2.Country = 'CZE'

questions.question: Who is the top spending customer and how much is the average price per single item purchased by this customer? What currency was being used?
questions.evidence: average price per single item = Total(price) / Total(amount)
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.CustomerID, SUM(T2.Price / T2.Amount), T1.Currency FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.CustomerID = ( SELECT CustomerID FROM yearmonth ORDER BY Consumption DESC LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY T2.CustomerID, T1.Currency

questions.question: Please list the countries of the gas stations with transactions taken place in June, 2013.
questions.evidence: June 2013 refers to '201306'; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; The 5th and 6th string of the date can refer to month;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Country FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID WHERE T3.Date = '201306'

questions.question: In February 2012, what percentage of customers consumed more than 528.3?
questions.evidence: February 2012 refers to '201202' in yearmonth.date; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; The 5th and 6th string of the date can refer to month.
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(Consumption > 528.3, 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(CustomerID) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date = '201202'

questions.question: What kind of currency did the customer paid at 16:25:00 in 2012/8/24?
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T3.Currency FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID INNER JOIN customers AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '16:25:00'

questions.question: How much did customer 6 consume in total between August and November 2013?
questions.evidence: Between August And November 2013 refers to Between 201308 And 201311; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; The 5th and 6th string of the date can refer to month.
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 6 AND Date BETWEEN '201308' AND '201311'

questions.question: In 2012, who had the least consumption in LAM?
questions.evidence: Year 2012 can be presented as Between 201201 And 201212; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year.
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.CustomerID FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' GROUP BY T1.CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which year recorded the most consumption of gas paid in CZK?
questions.evidence: The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year.
questions.SQL: SELECT SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many percent of LAM customer consumed more than 46.73?
questions.evidence: Percentage of LAM customer consumed more than 46.73 = (Total no. of LAM customers who consumed more than 46.73 / Total no. of LAM customers) * 100.
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Consumption > 46.73, 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM'
